scope: complete fast-only mu and temperature perturbation residual target for selected native pair; not an error bound or full RHS proof
target_definition: Y=Q_in(B+aK), using captured B,K,a and fixed C as exact given binary values; G*=K-F*(Y;C). Input formation inside Q(B+aK) belongs inside target; formation before captured B,K,C is excluded.

mass_flux.formula: On 80x40 independent physical core, M=mu+MUB (mu-floor inactive); C_u=(c1h*avg_x(M)+c2h)*u/msfuy and C_v=(c1h*avg_y(M)+c2h)*v/msfvx. divv=msftx*(-1/rdnw)*(rdx*Delta_x(C_u)+rdy*Delta_y(C_v)); Mdot=extend_mass(msfty*sum_k(divv)). Recorded profile has all six maps exactly one, periodic-X/symmetric-Y; Q enforces V wall zeros, aliases according to source.
mass_flux.conditional: Recompute from exact Q(B+aK) at each endpoint. Never substitute captured rounded Mdot or Omega without an explicit separate error bound. Current wrapper norm/eta etc from W target may be adapted without rerunning W.

mu.formula: For HEVI off, parity true, no floor/sanitize, F_mu=Q_mass(Mdot); G_mu=K_mu-F_mu. The packed alias mu_tend_scaled is unscaled mu_tend_for_conversion.
mu.gates: mu_tend_fortran_parity true skips mean subtraction and clamp. Divergence damping modifies U/V only and repacks mu unchanged. Q output copies periodic-X and symmetric-Y aliases.
mu.sanitizer_caveat: mu_tend_for_conversion aliases the tensor before check_tend reassigns mu_tend; if sanitization is enabled and mu is nonfinite, mu_tend_scaled may still refer to the earlier tensor. Captured sanitize_off avoids this ambiguity.

temperature.formula: For mode3, usesImplicitTransport false and do_explicit false, so coupled t_tend=0 (no horizontal/vertical theta advection or diffusion in this callback). F_t=Q_mass[-t_pert*c1h*Mdot/(c1h*(mu+MUB)+c2h+eps_theta)] and G_t=K_t-F_t; t_pert is the projected packed variable, not absolute theta.
temperature.omega: Omega is diagnosed as part of shared WRFMassFlux but no vertical Omega advection contributes to t_tend on this implicit-only path. Do not import explicit-stage advection or freeze a rounded Omega.
temperature.epsilon: eps_theta is getAutocastAwareEps applied to FP64 CPU mu tensor. If CPU FP16 autocast is disabled, exact promoted float32 1e-10 is 0x1.b7cdfe0000000p-34; if FP16 autocast is enabled source uses float32 1e-4. Old W reference manifest does not directly record autocast state; no active setter found in repository search. Either establish the thread state or model/bound both choices; do not silently assert observed default.
temperature.domain: Require finite positive source denominator c1h*(mu+MUB)+c2h+eps_theta, actual no-floor branch and fixed positive map denominators. Exact-real reference is not bitwise native arithmetic; compare directly against stored native R.

retained_data.available: B,K0,K1,R0,R1 full packed; theta_base,pbase,mub,c1h,c2h,c1f,c2f,mass_rdnw/eos_rdnw/pressure_rdn/top_rdnw; exact captured a,rdx,rdy and profile/unit-map gates. Original native W reference ensures correct U/V/mu/w hashes and Q mapping at both endpoints.
retained_data.scaling: capture layout records T min=max=1 and mu min=max=1 for actual S_inv; identity mask and N=1080491; sizes T=212544 and mu=3321. This is block extrema, not a saved full S_inv array; constancy follows exact equal min/max when all finite.
retained_data.availability_caveat: Archive and manifest verification needed before execution; external profile/receipt chain is bounded to selected pair and does not prove all hidden context or earlier B/K/C formation.

recommendation: An independent offline directed MPFR reference can calculate mu and T errors from retained full vectors and mass-flux coefficients without a native rerun or rerunning W. Reuse/adapt interval utilities with source attribution in a new standalone reference, but resolve or explicitly condition/bound eps_theta/autocast and branch assumptions before interpreting a bound. Build synthetic checks for nonzero K, seam/V walls, constant theta, zero/nonzero Mdot, sign/epsilon, alias rows and nonfinite/domain rejection.
limitations: These equations concern exact-real target for recorded source and selected profile; no bound on native rounding, reducer operations, full residual e_i or convergence follows until MPFR comparison and norm combination are completed.
No new native execution, experiments, code changes or tests.
